html:
In today’s rapidly evolving AI industry, UNIQUE RESEARCH’s monthly growth rankings consistently capture the attention of countless practitioners and investors. Drawing on our independent research into the AI sector and ongoing tracking of thousands of AI companies and nearly 10,000 AI products worldwide, we analyzed August 2025 data to identify AI Web products with both monthly visits and MAUs exceeding 100,000. Based on this, we compiled two rankings: the “Global AI Web Traffic Growth Top 10” and the “Global AI Web MAU Growth Top 10.”

There is partial overlap between the two lists, covering a total of 14 unique products. Most of these are emerging players with staggering growth rates—yet still relatively unfamiliar to many. We visited the websites of these 14 products and conducted a detailed breakdown to help the community quickly grasp their core value propositions, key features, and business models.

The largest share of products on the list are in video and image generation, underscoring the booming momentum of multimodal content creation. By leveraging automation, multi-model aggregation, and vertical applications, these tools are pushing AI content production to new heights.

01. FacelessReels: Fully Automated “Faceless” Short Video Pipeline
A subscription-based tool that auto-generates and auto-publishes faceless short videos for creators and small teams on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

One-line overview: a “fully automated short video pipeline.” Users choose a niche, format, style, and soundtrack, connect social accounts, and the system automatically generates and publishes videos at set intervals—saving time, cutting costs, and enabling scale.

  • Core features (based on current webpage):

    • Series & topic management: Create “Series” with niche + format; AI handles generation.

    • Styles & assets: 6+ video art styles; custom music uploads or TikTok audio links.

    • Voiceover & synthesis: Custom AI voiceovers.

    • Auto publishing: Scheduled posting to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube.

    • Efficiency: “Videos in under 5 minutes,” multi-platform one-click distribution.

    • Ease of use: Designed for non-professional creators.

  • Target users & scenarios:

    • Solo creators/side hustlers: produce consistent content with minimal labor.

    • Small brands/teams: use replaceable, faceless videos for growth.

    • Popular niches: true crime, scary stories, history, heists, tragedies, moral tales.

  • Workflow:

    1. Create a Series (niche + format).

    2. Customize style, music, voiceover.

    3. Auto-publish to social platforms.

  • Business model: SaaS subscription (frequency-based tiers).

    • Hobby: $19–29/mo, 3 posts/week.

    • Daily: $39–59/mo, 1 post/day.

    • Pro: $69–89/mo, 2 posts/day.

    • All tiers: auto posting, AI voice, 6+ styles, no watermark, 1 concurrent Series.

  • Proof & adoption:

    • Screenshots of real TikTok channels (e.g., @darktruthdaily1).

    • “Trusted by 37k+ users” claim.

    • Carousel of performance screenshots (no detailed metrics disclosed).

  • Why creators choose it:

    • Compared with outsourcing ($50–200 per clip) or DIY (script + shoot + edit), FacelessReels offers automation, scale, and multi-platform reach.

  • Known limitations:

    • 1 Series per plan.

    • FAQ hints at restrictions (monthly limits, refund policies), but details hidden unless logged in.

Key takeaway: A low-barrier, scalable, automated content pipeline for short-form video creators.

02. Memories.ai: Building the “Visual Memory Layer” of AI
Enables deep understanding and retrieval of long-form video. Users can query footage in natural language (e.g., “extract all fight scenes”). Targets enterprises (security, media) and professionals (creators, students). Pricing combines subscriptions + credits.

03. KomikoAI: One-stop Anime & Animation Creation
An end-to-end tool for manga/anime creation: character design, image generation, AI canvas, keyframe animation. Integrates GPT-4o, Kling, Flux, etc. Free tier available, with 100k+ creators onboard.

04. Lanta AI & Flux Pro AI: Multi-Model “Arsenals”

  • Lanta AI: multi-model video generation (text-to-video, image-to-video, style transfer). Integrates Hunyuan Video, Wan 2.1, etc. Uses free credits for onboarding.

  • Flux Pro AI: image & video creation suite integrating Flux, Kling, Google Veo. Transparent pricing with subscriptions + credit packs.

05. AI Facefy & RoboNeo: Face Effects & Visual Editing

  • AI Facefy: face-driven effects (AI kissing, face-dance, trending memes). Privacy promise: uploads deleted within 24 hours.

  • RoboNeo (by Meitu): AI design assistant for images and video, leveraging Meitu’s strong mobile editing expertise.

AI assistants are embedding into everyday workflows—browsing, writing, learning languages—making processes faster and smarter.

01. MaxAI: Browser extension for in-page AI chat, summarization, writing, translation. Multi-model aggregation with contextual awareness. Freemium model.

02. Trancy: Immersive AI language learning. Bilingual subtitles for YouTube/Netflix, instant word lookup, grammar analysis, speaking practice. Also works for web reading.

03. DocuWriter.ai: Developer-focused tool for automated documentation, Swagger specs, test cases, UML. Integrates with Git/n8n. Subscription tiers by generation volume.

AI is moving beyond general tools into education, biology, and other niches.

01. Class Companion: AI teaching assistant for K–12 and higher ed. Offers instant homework feedback, personalized tutoring, analytics. Free for teachers; paid school/district plans with LMS integration and integrity checks.

02. Plantin: Plant & fungi identification and care. Photo-based diagnosis, personalized care, and expert consultations with botanists/mycologists.

As base models advance, new platforms make them easier to use and compare.

01. Z.ai: Free GLM-4.5-based chatbot with tools (slides, code, search) + API access.

02. LMArena: Transparent multi-model “arena” for side-by-side comparisons. Users vote on outputs; crowdsourced feedback builds public leaderboards. Explicit reminders about privacy/data sharing.

  1. Video explosion: Nearly half are tied to video creation/editing/understanding, reflecting surging demand for dynamic content.

  2. Multi-model aggregation: Increasingly, platforms integrate multiple top-tier models to enhance choice and quality.

  3. Deepening verticals: From education to botany, AI is embedding in specialized workflows.

  4. Freemium + subscription/credits: Free entry drives adoption, while tiered monetization ensures scalability.

Tracking these fast-growing “hidden gems” not only introduces new tools but also reveals where AI evolution is headed. The next application to transform our work and life could be among them.

As a global authority on AI market insights, UNIQUE RESEARCH’s data and analysis are widely trusted by leading investment institutions, universities, and media. Our insights have been cited by firms including GF Securities, CSC, Huayuan Securities, Haitong Securities, and outlets such as China Securities Journal, TMTPost, and Jiemian News.

We believe only data validated by core industry stakeholders has enduring value. To that end, we commit to:

  1. Permanent open access: This AI product ranking is open-source and fully replicable, with full methodology and raw data.

  2. Independent third-party sources only: No company self-reported data accepted.

  3. Absolute neutrality: Rankings are not influenced by commercial deals or paid placements.

  • Investors/analysts: A reverse-engineerable, reliable dataset for building models, surfacing hidden projects, and cross-validating.

  • Entrepreneurs/product managers: Identify competitors, benchmark performance, replicate our methodology for product iteration.

  • Researchers/students: Open-source data is an ideal foundation for academic and market studies.

Full datasets and charts are available at 100aiapps.cn. All data can be copied and freely used for personal learning/research; commercial use requires prior authorization from UNIQUE RESEARCH.

Beyond reports, we aim to build an open-source ecosystem for transparent AI market data. We invite developers, data scientists, and analysts to:

  • Replicate & verify: Access our Feishu knowledge base, reproduce results, propose improvements.

  • Contribute: Expand dimensions (API call volumes, agent monitoring, etc.).

  • Share insights: Join our Feishu group to exchange findings.

One person’s perspective is limited; collective intelligence is boundless. Together, let’s define the metrics for the AI market.
